answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus on the challenging problem of extracting informative arguments of events from the document.
answer_1.outputs: The generation model takes (1) context: the concatenation of the piece of text x (of document D) containing the current event trigger and the event type's corresponding template in the ontology; (2) memory store m: of previously extracted events of the same document D, as input, and learns a distribution p(y|x, m) over possible outputs y.

answer_2.quote: We consider an argument span to be correctly identified if its offsets match any of the gold/reference informative arguments of the current event (i.e., argument identification); and it is correctly classified if its semantic role also matches (i.e., argument classification).
